assumptions: The card prompt names no unit objective beyond 'one writer that refuses null rows, plus an audit of every cell'. No 'row-schema' or 'null-field' vocabulary existed in STATUS.md / VERDICTS.md / docs/, so the referent was taken to be the documented null/key-gap defect family (U8.40/U8.43 contracted-key gaps, the C-curated CONFIRMS-without-producer docket row). Recorded here rather than asked (automated session).

Three tiers instead of one: a single 'refuse every NULL' rule would have rejected 4 honest families of NULL already in the live store (run 3 never finished; root lanes have no parent; replay-produced candidates have no model id; assembler-written dockets have no lane row). Tier 1 refuses, tier 2 is a named backlog pinned by test, tier 3 carries a null_means reason.

web_sources is router-tier: a failed fetch has no bytes (no sha256) and no status, and 'no row' would erase the failure the plan requires recorded. The writer is upsert_web_source and it must call row_schema.router_insert(method=...); any other writer is refused those NULLs.

The 12 test files were edited to supply required values rather than the profiles being loosened. Each edit supplies a value the test's own scenario implies (e.g. a docket fixture gets a minimal manifest, a lane seed gets the target it already had, an evidence row gets a pinned date).
No live request was made: no Occamy, no SearXNG, no .occamy.lock taken. state/state.sqlite was only ever opened read-only (file:...?mode=ro) by the audit.
SCHEMA_VERSION stays 4; the profiles describe v4 and are asserted to cover every column of every table.
bound_note: The 30-call bound was declared for a single-pass edit+verify. It was exceeded because the first two verification passes were worthless: the bypass scan's regex only matched within a single line, so it reported 'no bypass sites' against a store that contained two, and the red->green harness ran the copy's tests against the *parent* src/ (import-resolution), so every reverted run reported green. Both were found only by making the harness falsifiable (a control assertion that the scan must match the multi-line shape; PYTHONPATH into the copy; an assertion that the revert changed the bytes). Repairing genuine red for 12 test files then dominated the remaining calls.
